SH-22.title: Display "Default" for untyped stories + reserve "default" slug
SH-22.acceptance_criteria: (1) src/output.rs:342 fallback changed from "-" to "Default". (2) src/output.rs:256-259 list view renders [Default] badge for story_type == None. (3) src/storage.rs add_type rejects slug "default" (case-insensitive). (4) Update tests: story_types.rs and story_import.rs. (5) New test: type_add_rejects_reserved_default_slug. (6) No use of storage or types.toml added to output.rs.
SH-22.design_section:
### output.rs — Display Changes

- **Purpose:** Render type and progress in human-readable and JSON output.
- **Key decisions:**
  - When displaying, `story_type: None` renders as the default type from `types.toml`
  - JSON output includes raw `story_type` (may be `null` for old stories) and `progress` via serde

### storage.rs — Config Loading & Persistence

- `add_type(root, slug, description) -> Result<TypeDef>` — validates no duplicates, rejects reserved slugs ("none")
- Reserved slugs: "none" is forbidden in `add_type`

SH-23.title: Add import validation for story_type against types.toml
SH-23.acceptance_criteria: (1) src/app.rs: before import loop (~L725-730), call load_type_map(root)?. (2) Collect and validate ALL import_story.story_type values before loop. (3) Error message lists ALL invalid types. (4) Zero stories created on validation failure. (5) New tests: import_rejects_invalid_story_type, import_atomicity_on_type_error, import_accepts_valid_story_type.
SH-23.design_section:
### app.rs — Command Handlers

- **Purpose:** Business logic for type/epic commands, progress rollup, list filtering, next-story parent skipping.
- **Key decisions:**
  - Type validation at write time: check slug exists in `load_type_map`

### storage.rs — Config Loading & Persistence

- `load_type_map(root) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, TypeDef>>` — keyed by slug
